instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Define how agents work in {{project}}. Rules, roles and overrides stay in this project.
instructions.emptyDetail: Instructions are the rules Orchester adds to agents’ prompts: for the whole project, a role, a pipeline or one step. They are versioned like pipelines, and runs use a published version, never a draft.
instructions.ownership:
Owned by {{project}}.
Versioned with every run.
instructions.name: Name
instructions.publishNote: Publishing applies to new runs. Active runs keep v{{version}}.
instructions.publishedNotice: Published v{{version}}. New runs use it; active runs keep the versions they started with.
instructions.leaveDetail: Your unsaved changes will be left behind. Saved drafts and published versions are kept.
instructions.unavailable: Unavailable · no value in this context
instructions.missingNote: Missing values are flagged before the agent starts.
instructions.noEmptyValue: This value is never silently replaced with empty text. Choose a run that has it, or another variable.
instructions.noFallback: Fallback values are not available yet: the agent does not start until the value exists.
instructions.systemNote: The runtime adds result instructions, skills and the code index when a run starts. The full prompt preview shows the context available now.
instructions.previewDraftContext: Draft preview · a run started now
instructions.draftSubstituted: Draft rule substituted for its published version.
instructions.secretNote: Secret values stay out of agent prompts, variable previews and copied instructions.
instructions.fixBeforePreview: Fix the marked fields to preview this draft.
instructions.missingVariable: {{variable}} has no value for {{source}} at this injection event.
instructions.noTasks: Select a task after creating one to preview its prompt.
instructions.noPipeline: This task needs a published pipeline to preview its prompt.
instructions.noAgentSteps: This pipeline has no step with a published agent profile.
instructions.viewerNote: Draft preview only. Existing runs keep the instruction versions they started with. The skills and the code index part are added when a run starts.
instructions.importDetail: Found in {{folder}}. Choose what becomes a draft in Orchester; open an item to see what it will contain.
instructions.importReadFailed: Repository agent files could not be read.
instructions.importFailed: Drafts could not be created. Your selection is kept; try again.
instructions.importEmpty: No instruction files or skills were found in this repository.
instructions.importNote: You review and publish each draft yourself. Agents read the repository’s own AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and skills only while Project settings › Repository agent files is on.
instructions.importOnlyPoints: Only points to {{targets}} ({{references}}) · nothing to import
instructions.importUnsupported: Unsupported reference file paths · cannot import
instructions.outsideChange: This instruction changed elsewhere. Your typed text is kept; reload before saving or publishing.
instructions.newPublishNote: Publishing makes the rule apply to new runs.
instructions.notSaved: Not saved · fix the marked fields

catalog.taskId: The key of the current task
catalog.taskTitle: The title of the current task
catalog.runBaseRevision: The revision the run started from

instructions.emptyTabDetail: A project rule is added to the prompts of the agents it applies to, when they start or resume a step.
instructions.importDraftsOnly: Creates drafts only: nothing is published and no repository file changes
instructions.insertPrevented: The editor prevented this insertion. Try again when it is ready.
instructions.insertNotMounted: The prompt editor is unavailable. Reopen it before inserting a variable.
instructions.insertMasked: A variable cannot be inserted into a masked field.
instructions.insertComposing: Finish the input-method composition before inserting a variable.
instructions.insertInvalidSelection: The editor selection is invalid. Choose a position in the prompt and try again.
instructions.foundSkills: {{count}} skills · each becomes a draft skill in Skills
instructions.importScope: Project · change it in the editor
instructions.importInstructionGroup: Instructions · each becomes a draft project instruction
instructions.importSkillGroup: Skills · each becomes a draft skill
instructions.automationDraftSaved: Draft written by automation · Published v{{version}}
instructions.automationNewDraft: Draft written by automation · Not published
instructions.roleNote: An agent role rule is added to the prompt of every agent with that role, after the profile’s own role instructions.
instructions.stepNote: A step override is added to the prompt of one pipeline step, after the step’s own instructions. {{step}} runs {{role}}.
instructions.editingNote: Edits save as a draft. New runs keep getting v{{version}} until you publish.
instructions.revisionExplanation: {{role}} starts {{step}} before the run’s first checkpoint commit. Orchester never fills a missing value with empty text: the agent would not start.
instructions.resumePolicyNote: Changes this rule’s Inject at. A resumed agent gets the commit its worktree is at: its latest checkpoint, a commit it made itself, or the base revision.
instructions.unavailableDetail: {{role}} would not start with this rule, and {{step}} would fail naming the variable. Publishing waits until the variable has a value at the rule’s event.
instructions.unavailableDetailAnyAgent: An agent would not start with this rule, and its step would fail naming the variable. Publishing waits until the variable has a value at the rule’s event.
instructions.viewerFooter: Source {{source}} of {{total}} · {{count}} variable resolved at this injection event
instructions.viewerFooterMany: Source {{source}} of {{total}} · {{count}} variables resolved at this injection event
instructions.publishWaiting: Publishing waits until required variables have values at this rule’s event.
instructions.publishedNoticeOne: Published v{{version}}. New runs use it; 1 active run keeps its version ({{runs}}).
instructions.publishedNoticeMany: Published v{{version}}. New runs use it; {{count}} active runs keep their versions ({{runs}}).
instructions.publishSaveWaiting: Publish waits until the draft is saved.
instructions.writeFailed: This instruction could not be saved or published.
instructions.publishFailedRetained: {{reason}} Your draft v{{draft}} is kept, and new runs still get v{{published}}.
instructions.publishFailedUnpublished: {{reason}} Your draft v{{draft}} is kept. No version has been published.
instructions.orderNote: Groups follow the order prompts assemble them: agent role, project rules, pipeline, step, then the task.
instructions.orphanStep: Step override · its step or pipeline was deleted · open it to move or remove it
instructions.orphanPipeline: Pipeline override · its pipeline was deleted · open it to move or remove it
instructions.emptyProjectDetail: Added to the prompts of every agent, or of the agents a rule names.
instructions.emptyRolesDetail: Each profile's role gets its rules here, after the profile's own role instructions.
instructions.emptyPipelinesDetail: Added to the prompts of one pipeline's agents, after the project and role rules.
instructions.emptyStepsDetail: Added to the prompt of one pipeline step, after the step's own instructions.
instructions.pageSub: {{scope}} · Owned by {{project}} · versioned with every run
instructions.barDraft: Draft v{{next}} · {{saved}} · Based on Published v{{version}}

instructions.scopeStepHint: One pipeline step, after the step's own instructions.
instructions.applyHintProject: Project rule: the agents it names, or all agents
instructions.applyHintPipeline: Pipeline: the agents it names, or all its agents
